create_TD3_agent: create a TD3 reinforcement learning agent with actor and critic networks for continuous control
select_action_TD3: select an action from the TD3 actor network given a state observation
train_TD3_agent: train the TD3 agent using replay buffer samples with delayed policy updates and target networks
save_TD3_model: save the TD3 actor and critic network weights to disk as PyTorch checkpoint files
load_TD3_model: load previously saved TD3 actor and critic network weights from PyTorch checkpoint files
